content.text: {"name":"V05_yoy_persist6_temporal","hypothesis":"Groups whose V05 dollars-per-hour level has risen in a larger share of recent months (persist over 6 months) will have higher returns next month, because steady upward momentum in this average reflects continuing strength that is priced in slowly.","falsified_if":"Mean cross-sectional rank IC is non-positive or HAC t-statistic is below 1 in development data, or the top-minus-bottom quintile spread is negative.","expression":"persist(V05,6)"}
